# Conformance focus list - TEMPORARY, delete this file before merging.

# While this file exists the CI matrix runs only the cases named here instead of
# all ~125. It exists so the cases still failing on the parent PR can be
# iterated on in minutes rather than hours.
#
# One name per line; blank lines and #-comments are ignored. A name that matches
# no test case is reported as a workflow warning, not a silent no-op.

# Failed on the parent PR's last run: leaked gateways sat on a quota of 5.
# The cleanup that should have removed them was silently broken (fixed in
# 38329f0); this proves the fix.

# Same quota family - passed locally after the manual cleanup, unproven in CI.

# wildcard (3e92db4).

alloydb-user
alloydb-backup

# MessageBusesPerProjectPerRegion is 1 and the crud phase's bus outlived it.

# Failed in CI within a second because the CI service account lacked
# roles/workflows.admin. Role granted; unproven since.

# Both failed once on "timeout waiting for agent to become ready after 30s", an
